tagline.en_US: A self-hosted form builder using its bundled SQLite configuration for a single-container setup. The application key is required to encrypt stored data.

description.en_US: Input is an open-source, no-code application for building clean and customizable forms. It serves as a self-hosted alternative to proprietary form builders like TypeForm. Users can design conversational forms and adjust visual styles to match their organization's branding.
